title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Public Lighting - Farola
description: A complete point of light, composed of a post, one or more luminaires (which in turn contain lamps) and optionally a junction box (edintalu:Farola, subclass of edint-infraestructura's UrbanElement).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Farola'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geojson reference to the item. Point providing the geographical position of the entity.

coordinates.description: Property. Coordinates of the Point, in WGS84 [longitude, latitude] order.

address.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/address'. The mailing address (edintalu:direccion, reusing esdir:DireccionPostal).

infrastructureType.description: Relationship. Reference to a concept of edint-infraestructura's InfrastructureType controlled vocabulary, e.g. StreeLamp. Inherited from UrbanElement/Facility.

poste.description: Relationship. The Poste (physical support) of this streetlight -- exactly one (edintalu:poste).

luminaria.description: Relationship. The Luminaria(s) of this streetlight, one or more, e.g. LED+DISCHARGE (edintalu:luminaria).

caja.description: Relationship. The Caja (junction box) of this streetlight, if it has an accessible one (edintalu:caja).

centroDeMando.description: Relationship. The CentroDeMando (control center) this streetlight depends on (edintalu:centroDeMando).

claseLuminotecnica.description: Property. Lighting class per UNE-EN 13201 (edintalu:claseLuminotecnica): a=motorways, b=arterial, c=collector, d=residential, e=pedestrian.

tipoAlumbrado.description: Property. Lighting class per EN 13201 (edintalu:tipoAlumbrado): S/C/ME/CE series codes.

tipoIluminacion.description: Property. Type of illumination regime (edintalu:tipoIluminacion): nighttime or permanent.

zonaAlumbrado.description: Property. Light-pollution protection zone per REEAE RD 1890/2008 (edintalu:zonaAlumbrado): e1=maximum protection to e4=low protection.

calidadDato.description: Property. Data quality code: B (good), R (regular), M (poor), E (under construction) (edintalu:calidadDato).

horasDeFuncionamiento.description: Property. Schedule when the lighting is on, e.g. '22:00-07:00' (edintalu:horasDeFuncionamiento).

metodoDeControl.description: Property. Method for switching the lighting on/off, e.g. astronomical clock, photocell, remote management (edintalu:metodoDeControl). The source ontology does not constrain this to a controlled vocabulary.

numeroDeLuminarias.description: Property. Number of luminaires in the streetlight (edintalu:numeroDeLuminarias).
